title: Eton Mess
hookLine: British-inspired eton mess with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Eton Mess
steps.instructionTemplate: Purée half the strawberries in a blender. Chop the remaining strawberries, reserving four for decoration. Keep {m52791_1}, {m52791_2}, {m52791_3}, and {m52791_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure strawberries first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Eton Mess
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip the double cream until stiff peaks form, then fold in the strawberry purée and crushed meringue. Fold in the chopped strawberries and ginger cordial, if using. Incorporate {m52791_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Eton Mess
steps.instructionTemplate: Spoon equal amounts of the mixture into four cold wine glasses. Serve garnished with the remaining strawberries and a sprig of mint.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Eton Mess coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 4 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
